name: Cloisonné small box
about: Beijing cloisonné is a traditional craft. Fine metal wires are filled with colored enamel by hand, and the box is polished smooth.
tip: Ask whether it is handmade. Mass-printed pieces look similar but cost much less.

name: Jasmine tea
where: Wu Yu Tai official shops in Qianmen or Wangfujing
about: Tea drinking is a long-standing part of Beijing life. Jasmine tea is scented with dried jasmine flowers and is a local favorite.
tip: Prices vary a lot by leaf grade and flower scent. Compare grades before you buy.

name: Small calligraphy brush
about: Rongbaozhai is an old Beijing shop for painting and calligraphy supplies. Its brushes are made for traditional Chinese writing.
tip: Check the hair material and the intended use before you buy, since brushes differ for ink work and for painting.
